item.title: Show HN: LocalGPT – A local-first AI assistant in Rust with persistent memory
item.description:
📝 cargo install localgpt Why LocalGPT. localgpt/workspace/ ├── MEMORY. localgpt/workspace" CLI Commands # Chat localgpt chat # Interactive chat localgpt chat --session <id> # Resume session localgpt ask "question" # Single question # Daemon localgpt daemon start # Start background daemon localgpt daemon stop # Stop daemon localgpt daemon status # Show status localgpt daemon heartbeat # Run one heartbeat cycle # Memory localgpt memory search "query" # Search memory localgpt memory reindex # Reindex files localgpt memory stats # Show statistics # Config localgpt config init # Create default config localgpt config show # Show current config HTTP API When the daemon is running: Endpoint Description GET /health Health check GET /api/status Server status POST /api/chat Chat with the assistant GET /api/memory/search.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/localgpt-app/localgpt

item.title: FDA intends to take action against non-FDA-approved GLP-1 drugs
item.description:
📝 Commissioner of Food and Drugs - Food and Drug Administration Today, the U. In promotional materials, companies cannot claim that non-FDA-approved compounded products are generic versions or the same as drugs approved by FDA. They also cannot state compounded drugs use the same active ingredient as the FDA-approved drugs or that compounded drugs are clinically proven to produce results for the patient.
🔗 Read more: https://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-intends-take-action-against-non-fda-approved-glp-1-drugs
